rows.grounds: compound of āśā and abhimukha; facing desire
compound of tripurī, kṛta, and vigraha; form made tripurī

items.question: What bodily transformation occurs when the practitioner becomes oriented toward desire?
items.inference: orientation toward desire results in a tripurī-made form
uncertainties: exact ritual referent of tripurīkṛtavigraha remains unclear
items.plain_english: Then, having become oriented toward desire, his form is made tripurī.
